articles.summary: ATLANTA , Dec. 01, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Acuity Inc. (NYSE: AYI) (the “Company”) will release fiscal 2026 first-quarter results on Thursday, January 8, 2026 at 6:00 a.m. ET , followed by a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET . Neil Ashe , Chief Executive Officer of Acuity Inc. , will lead the call.
articles.title: Acuity to Announce Fiscal 2026 First-Quarter Results on January 8, 2026
